d.ko: Programmer Lin Mo is tired of his monotonous life. One day, he meets a mysterious girl at a café who hides many secrets. As lies and true feelings intertwine, can this chance encounter save him from his numb existence? A visual novel filled with "love and hope".
d.en: Programmer Lin Mo is tired of his monotonous life. One day, he meets a mysterious girl at a café who hides many secrets. As lies and true feelings intertwine, can this chance encounter save him from his numb existence? A visual novel filled with "love and hope".
d.zh: 程序员林默早已厌倦了日复一日的枯燥工作。直到那天，他在常去的咖啡馆，遇到了一位神秘少女。因为一场哭笑不得的误会，他和这个名叫苏幼晴的女孩有了交集。当谎言与真心交织，这场意外的邂逅，能否将彼此从各自的牢笼中拯救？
